title: Marcos says Michelin Guide ‘important opportunity’ to lure more tourists, help MSMEs in PH
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Thursday expressed optimism that the Philippines’ growing number of Michelin-awarded restaurants and hotels would attract more tourists.
